_meta.source: Written for claudeDM (Noir category). Original content; a few general-mechanics sentences (opportunity attacks, death saves, conditions) are adapted from SRD 5.1, licensed CC BY 4.0 — see NOTICE.
_meta.notes: Noir adversaries in the same schema as data/rules/monsters.json and the Sci-Fi adversaries.json, so LookupMonster can read them. Weapon actions follow the gunplay rules in combat.json: ranged attacks list range and magazine; a 'Burst' line gives the -2 to-hit and the extra damage die; Full Auto and Suppressive Fire are DEX/WIS save actions with DC 8 + proficiency + DEX modifier (Noir full auto deals two weapon dice). Knockout blows give their CON save DC. Everyone is human (type 'humanoid', subtype 'human'); dogs are 'beast'. Bosses fight through other people: their reactions (Get Him!, Human Shield) and actions direct allies rather than deal damage, and their CR assumes the entourage named in their special abilities is present. Badge and Heat abilities refer to investigation.json heat. Each entry carries an 'eras' tag (all are available in all three eras). XP follows the standard XP-by-CR table.

0.name: Pickpocket
0.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Penknife
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

special_abilities.name: Light Fingers
special_abilities.desc: The pickpocket lifts a wallet, a key or a letter from a creature it brushes past with a Sleight of Hand check against the creature's passive Perception. The victim notices the loss at the worst possible moment.

special_abilities.name: Scram
special_abilities.desc: The pickpocket can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action. It runs from any fight and is caught only in a chase (combat.json chases).

0.name: Stool Pigeon
0.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Fists
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 − 1) bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Sings
special_abilities.desc: For $5, a drink or a favor, the stool pigeon tells one true rumor and one he made up to keep the money coming. A DC 12 Insight check tells which is which. He is never the only source of a core clue, but he is often the quickest.

special_abilities.name: Both Sides of the Street
special_abilities.desc: Whoever pays the stool pigeon next learns what the last person asked him about. Leaning on him (Intimidation) gets the truth and raises Heat by 1: he runs to someone.

1.name: Hired Gun
1.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hired gun makes two .45 Automatic attacks.

actions.name: .45 Automatic
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. Magazine 7, reload bonus action. Jams on a natural 1.

actions.name: Pistol-Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Paid by the Day
special_abilities.desc: The hired gun leaves the fight when the man paying it is down, or when it is clearly losing. It doesn't take a bullet for anyone.

1.name: Bodyguard
1.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bodyguard makes two Brass Knuckles attacks, or one .45 Automatic attack.

actions.name: Brass Knuckles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: .45 Automatic
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. Magazine 7, reload bonus action. Jams on a natural 1.

special_abilities.name: Eyes Open
special_abilities.desc: The bodyguard can't be surprised while the person it protects is in sight, and has advantage on Perception checks to spot a concealed weapon.

reactions.name: Take the Bullet
reactions.desc: When the creature the bodyguard is protecting is hit by an attack while within 5 ft of the bodyguard, the bodyguard becomes the target of the attack instead.

1.name: Knife Artist
1.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The knife artist makes two Switchblade attacks.

actions.name: Switchblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Thrown Knife
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. It carries three.

special_abilities.name: Opens You Up
special_abilities.desc: When the knife artist hits the same creature with both Switchblade attacks in one turn, that creature is Bleeding (combat.json conditions).

special_abilities.name: Slip Away
special_abilities.desc: The knife artist can take the Disengage action as a bonus action.

1.name: Prizefighter
1.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The prizefighter makes two Punch attacks.

actions.name: Punch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. On a critical hit the target must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be knocked out (unconscious for 1d4 minutes, stable, not at 0 HP).

special_abilities.name: Footwork
special_abilities.desc: The prizefighter's AC includes a +1 bonus for footwork, which it loses while grappled, prone or in a space too small to move in (a phone booth, a car).

special_abilities.name: Clean Fighter
special_abilities.desc: A prizefighter in a fistfight punches; it doesn't pull a gun, and it knocks out the people it drops. Somebody else in the room may not be so particular.

reactions.name: Roll With It
reactions.desc: When hit by a melee attack, the prizefighter reduces the damage by 1d6.

1.name: Motorcycle Cop
1.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The motorcycle cop makes two .38 Revolver attacks.

actions.name: .38 Revolver
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. Cylinder 6, reload action. Never jams.

actions.name: Nightstick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. Knockout blow from surprise: DC 11 CON save or unconscious for 1d4 x 10 minutes (combat.json brawling).

special_abilities.name: Pursuit Rider
special_abilities.desc: On a police motorcycle (combat.json vehicles), the cop has advantage on Driving checks in a chase in traffic and ignores the first complication.

special_abilities.name: Badge
special_abilities.desc: Attacking the officer where anyone can see raises Heat by 1; killing the officer raises it by 3 and puts every cop in the city on the case (investigation.json heat).

1.name: Torch
1.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Molotov Cocktail
actions.desc: The torch throws a Molotov at a point within 60 ft: each creature within 5 ft makes a DC 12 DEX save, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The area burns for 1 minute (equipment.json Molotov cocktail). It carries 1d4 + 2 bottles.

actions.name: Straight Razor
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Another Bottle (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: As a bonus action: the torch throws a second Molotov cocktail.

special_abilities.name: Accelerant
special_abilities.desc: Given a minute and a can of gasoline in a room, the torch sets a fire that spreads three rooms a minute instead of one. The smell of gasoline is a DC 10 Perception check, and a fire it set is a clue: a Forensics check (DC 12) on the ashes finds where it started and with what.

special_abilities.name: Firebug
special_abilities.desc: The torch takes no damage from its own fires on the turn it sets them, and always knows the way out of a burning building.

2.name: Mob Torpedo
2.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The torpedo makes two .38 Revolver attacks, or one Sawed-off Shotgun attack.

actions.name: .38 Revolver
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. Cylinder 6, reload action. Never jams.

actions.name: Sawed-off Shotgun
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 15/45 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. Scatter: +2 to hit within 30 ft. Two barrels, reload action. Both barrels at once: +1d8 damage, spends 2 shells.

special_abilities.name: The Contract
special_abilities.desc: The torpedo was sent for one person. It has advantage on its first attack roll against that person in each fight, and it would rather finish the job than win the fight.

special_abilities.name: Cold
special_abilities.desc: The torpedo is immune to being frightened and doesn't talk unless someone it fears more than its boss is asking.

2.name: Tommy-Gun Hood
2.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Tommy Gun
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 50/150 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. Drum magazine 50 (20 with a stick), reload action with a drum. Jams on a natural 1. Burst (3 rounds): +2 to hit, 11 (2d10) piercing damage on a hit, no ability modifier.

actions.name: Full Auto
actions.desc: Full Auto (10 rounds). The hood sprays a 10-ft cube whose nearest edge is within 50 ft. Each creature in the cube, friend or foe, must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Cover adds to the save.

actions.name: Suppressive Fire
actions.desc: Suppressive Fire (10 rounds). The hood covers a 20-ft-wide lane out to 50 ft. Until the start of its next turn, any creature that enters the lane or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be Suppressed (disadvantage on attack rolls and can't move closer to the shooter until the end of its next turn); a creature that fails by 5 or more also takes 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rifle Butt
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Drum Fed
special_abilities.desc: The hood comes with a drum fitted (50 rounds) and a spare 20-round stick: 70 rounds in all, which is five sprays of full auto and then nothing. The GM tracks them.

special_abilities.name: Spray and Pray
special_abilities.desc: The hood doesn't care who else is in the cube. Every burst of full auto adds 2 to the noise count instead of 1.

2.name: Bent Detective
2.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The detective makes two .38 Revolver attacks, or one Blackjack attack and one .38 Revolver attack.

actions.name: .38 Revolver
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage. Cylinder 6, reload action. Never jams.

actions.name: Blackjack
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage. Knockout blow from surprise: DC 11 CON save or unconscious for 1d4 x 10 minutes (combat.json brawling).

special_abilities.name: Badge
special_abilities.desc: Attacking the detective where anyone can see raises Heat by 2; killing the detective raises it by 4 and puts every cop in the city on the case (investigation.json heat).

special_abilities.name: Knows the File
special_abilities.desc: The detective has read everything the department has on the players. He has advantage on Insight checks against them, and he knows their addresses.

special_abilities.name: Frame Job
special_abilities.desc: Once per case, out of combat, the detective can plant evidence or pull a witness's statement: Heat rises by 2 against one player character. The plant is itself a clue that points back at him (Forensics or Investigation, DC 13).

2.name: Federal Agent
2.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The agent makes two .45 Automatic attacks.

actions.name: .45 Automatic
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. Magazine 7, reload bonus action. Jams on a natural 1.

actions.name: Pump Shotgun
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage. Scatter: +2 to hit within 30 ft. Tube of 5, reload action. From the car.

special_abilities.name: Federal Jurisdiction
special_abilities.desc: Local police defer to the agent, and obstructing him is a federal crime. Crossing him raises Heat by 2; he has a car, a telephone and a field office, and in the 1930s papers he is a "G-man".

special_abilities.name: By the Book
special_abilities.desc: The agent has advantage on Research and Investigation checks involving records, bank accounts, tax filings and interstate shipments, and he can get a subpoena in a day.

2.name: Rival Private Eye
2.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The private eye makes two .38 Revolver attacks, or one Blackjack attack and one .38 Revolver attack.

actions.name: .38 Revolver
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. Cylinder 6, reload action. Never jams.

actions.name: Blackjack
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage. Knockout blow from surprise: DC 11 CON save or unconscious for 1d4 x 10 minutes (combat.json brawling).

special_abilities.name: Already Been Here
special_abilities.desc: If the rival reached a witness or a scene first, he has talked to the witness, and now the witness wants money or a favor to say it again (investigation.json bribes_and_favors). He never destroys a core clue: what he took, he has, and he can be made to share.

special_abilities.name: Professional Courtesy
special_abilities.desc: The rival can be bargained with. A DC 13 Persuasion check, or something he wants, gets him to trade one fact for one fact. He works for someone else, and that someone is a clue.

2.name: Loan Shark
2.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: .32 Pocket Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. Magazine 8, reload bonus action. Jams on a natural 1.

actions.name: Break His Fingers
actions.desc: Up to two allies within 30 ft that can hear the loan shark each use their reaction to make one melee attack with advantage.

special_abilities.name: Never Without Collectors
special_abilities.desc: The loan shark is always with two Street Toughs or a Bouncer, and does none of its own hitting if it can help it.

special_abilities.name: The Vig
special_abilities.desc: The loan shark knows everyone in the neighborhood who owes it and how much. It has advantage on Intimidation checks against any debtor, and a debtor's name is always worth something.

reactions.name: Get Him!
reactions.desc: When a creature the loan shark can see attacks it or moves within 10 ft of it, the loan shark points and shouts: one ally within 60 ft that can hear it uses its reaction to move up to half its speed and make one weapon attack against that creature.

3.name: Mob Lieutenant
3.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lieutenant makes two .45 Automatic attacks.

actions.name: .45 Automatic
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. Magazine 7, reload bonus action. Jams on a natural 1.

actions.name: Pistol-Whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Move It! (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: As a bonus action: one ally within 30 ft that can hear the lieutenant uses its reaction to move up to half its speed and make one weapon attack.

special_abilities.name: Muscle Around Him
special_abilities.desc: The lieutenant is rarely alone: two to four Street Toughs or Hired Guns are within earshot.

reactions.name: Get Him!
reactions.desc: When a creature the lieutenant can see attacks it or moves within 10 ft of it, the lieutenant points and shouts: one ally within 60 ft that can hear it uses its reaction to move up to half its speed and make one weapon attack against that creature.

3.name: Hit Man
3.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hit man makes two attacks with its .38 Revolver or Ice Pick.

actions.name: .38 Revolver
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. Cylinder 6, reload action. Never jams.

actions.name: Ice Pick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Garrote
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature it is behind or that is surprised. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can't breathe or speak and takes 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the hit man's turns.

special_abilities.name: Patient
special_abilities.desc: The hit man has advantage on initiative rolls. In the first round of combat, its hits against surprised creatures are critical hits.

special_abilities.name: Quiet Work
special_abilities.desc: It prefers the garrote, the ice pick or a .22 target pistol (quiet; equipment.json). Its work doesn't advance the noise count unless something goes wrong.

special_abilities.name: Gone
special_abilities.desc: After it drops a creature to 0 hit points, the hit man can take the Hide action as a bonus action, even while only lightly obscured.

3.name: Waterfront Boss
3.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Cargo Hook
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: .38 Revolver
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage. Cylinder 6, reload action. Never jams.

actions.name: Throw Him in the Bay
actions.desc: Up to two allies within 60 ft that can hear the boss each use their reaction to make one melee attack or one shove; a shove on a pier pushes 10 ft, into the water.

special_abilities.name: The Docks Are Mine
special_abilities.desc: On the waterfront, 1d4 + 1 Dockside Goons are always within whistle range and arrive in 1d4 rounds.

special_abilities.name: Union Card
special_abilities.desc: Hurting the boss where dockworkers can see raises Heat by 2, and no longshoreman in the city will talk to the players again this case.

reactions.name: Get Him!
reactions.desc: When a creature the boss can see attacks it or moves within 10 ft of it, the boss points and shouts: one ally within 60 ft that can hear it uses its reaction to move up to half its speed and make one weapon attack against that creature.

3.name: Ward Boss
3.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Derringer
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 10/30 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage. Two barrels, reload action.

actions.name: Somebody Do Something
actions.desc: Up to two allies within 60 ft that can hear the ward boss each use their reaction to move up to half their speed and make one weapon attack.

special_abilities.name: Machine Politics
special_abilities.desc: In his own ward, 1d4 Beat Cops arrive within 1d4 rounds of any trouble and take the ward boss's side. A call downtown raises the players' Heat by 2.

special_abilities.name: A Reasonable Man
special_abilities.desc: The ward boss would always rather make a deal. A DC 15 Persuasion check, or an offer of votes, money or silence, opens a parley.

reactions.name: Get Him!
reactions.desc: When a creature the ward boss can see attacks it or moves within 10 ft of it, the ward boss points and shouts: one ally within 60 ft that can hear it uses its reaction to move up to half its speed and make one weapon attack against that creature.

reactions.name: Human Shield
reactions.desc: When the ward boss is hit by a ranged attack while an ally is within 5 ft of it, the ward boss pulls the ally into the way and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

4.name: Mob Boss
4.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: .32 Pocket Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. Magazine 8, reload bonus action. Jams on a natural 1.

actions.name: Make an Example
actions.desc: Up to three allies within 60 ft that can hear the boss each use their reaction to make one weapon attack against a creature the boss names, with advantage.

actions.name: Not Here (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: As a bonus action: one ally within 30 ft moves up to its speed into a space between the boss and a creature it names, without provoking opportunity attacks.

special_abilities.name: Never Alone
special_abilities.desc: The boss is always with two Bodyguards and either a Mob Lieutenant or 1d4 + 2 Hired Guns. He does not fight; people fight for him.

special_abilities.name: A Reasonable Man
special_abilities.desc: He will always talk first, and he keeps his word to the letter. A DC 15 Persuasion check, or something he wants, opens a parley.

special_abilities.name: Long Memory
special_abilities.desc: Killing or humiliating the boss raises Heat by 3, and somebody always comes back for it.

reactions.name: Get Him!
reactions.desc: When a creature the boss can see attacks it or moves within 10 ft of it, the boss points and shouts: one ally within 60 ft that can hear it uses its reaction to move up to half its speed and make one weapon attack against that creature.

reactions.name: Human Shield
reactions.desc: When the boss is hit by a ranged attack while an ally is within 5 ft of it, the boss pulls the ally into the way and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.

4.name: Police Captain
4.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: .38 Revolver
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage. Cylinder 6, reload action. Never jams.

actions.name: Take Them Down
actions.desc: Up to three police allies within 60 ft that can hear the captain each use their reaction to make one weapon attack, or to move up to their speed toward a creature the captain names.

actions.name: Cover Me (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: As a bonus action: one police ally within 30 ft moves to put itself between the captain and a creature he names; the captain has half cover from that creature until the start of his next turn.

special_abilities.name: Badge
special_abilities.desc: Attacking the captain where anyone can see raises Heat by 3; killing the captain raises it by 5 and puts every cop in the city on the case (investigation.json heat).

special_abilities.name: Chain of Command
special_abilities.desc: The captain can order any player character who is a Cop, and can have a private investigator's license suspended with a telephone call. Most of what he does to the players, he does through paperwork.

reactions.name: Get Him!
reactions.desc: When a creature the captain can see attacks it or moves within 10 ft of it, the captain points and shouts: one ally within 60 ft that can hear it uses its reaction to move up to half its speed and make one weapon attack against that creature.

reactions.name: Officer Down (1/Day)
reactions.desc: When a police ally the captain can see drops to 0 hit points, 1d4 Beat Cops arrive at the edge of the scene at the start of the next round.

5.name: The Professional
5.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Professional makes three attacks with its .45 Automatic or its Hunting Rifle.

actions.name: .45 Automatic
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage. Magazine 7, reload bonus action. Its guns don't jam.

actions.name: Hunting Rifle
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 300/1200 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. Telescopic sight. Magazine 5, reload action.

actions.name: Ice Pick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Aim (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: As a bonus action: if it hasn't moved this turn, its next ranged attack this turn has advantage and its speed becomes 0.

special_abilities.name: Three Exits
special_abilities.desc: The Professional can't be surprised, and it always knows two ways out of wherever it is. It leaves when the job can't be done today; there is always tomorrow.

special_abilities.name: No Wasted Motion
special_abilities.desc: Once per turn it can reload as part of the Attack action, and its guns don't jam on a natural 1.

special_abilities.name: Did the Homework
special_abilities.desc: It knows the players' names, faces, addresses and car, and who they love. If they have never seen it, it has seen them.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: When an attacker it can see hits it, the Professional halves the attack's damage.

1/8.name: Street Tough
1/8.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Brass Knuckles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Snub-nose .38
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. Cylinder 5, reload action. Never jams.

special_abilities.name: Strength in Numbers
special_abilities.desc: The tough has advantage on melee attack rolls against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 ft of that creature and isn't incapacitated.

special_abilities.name: Cut and Run
special_abilities.desc: When reduced to half its hit points or fewer, the tough runs unless someone it is more afraid of than you is watching. Toughs who are only brawling knock out the people they drop.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

special_abilities.name: Alarm Bark
special_abilities.desc: When the dog notices an intruder, it barks; every watchman and guard within 300 ft is alerted. A steak with something in it (a knockout drop, combat.json nonlethal) keeps it quiet: DC 11 CON save.

1/4.name: Beat Cop
1/4.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Nightstick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. Knockout blow from surprise: DC 11 CON save or unconscious for 1d4 x 10 minutes (combat.json brawling).

actions.name: .38 Revolver
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage. Cylinder 6, reload action. Never jams.

special_abilities.name: Police Whistle
special_abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the cop blows his whistle. Every officer within 600 ft hears it, and 1d2 more Beat Cops arrive at the start of the third round after.

special_abilities.name: Badge
special_abilities.desc: Attacking the officer where anyone can see raises Heat by 1; killing the officer raises it by 3 and puts every cop in the city on the case (investigation.json heat).

special_abilities.name: Knows the Beat
special_abilities.desc: The cop knows every shopkeeper, doorman and drunk on his beat by name. Persuasion (DC 12) or a dollar gets you who has been around and when.

1/4.name: Bouncer
1/4.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Blackjack
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Knockout blow from surprise: DC 13 CON save or unconscious for 1d4 x 10 minutes (combat.json brawling).

special_abilities.name: Heave-Ho
special_abilities.desc: When the bouncer hits a creature with its Fist, it can try to grapple it as a bonus action, and it can drag a creature it is grappling at its full speed toward the nearest door.

special_abilities.name: House Rules
special_abilities.desc: The bouncer throws people out; it doesn't kill them. It knocks out anyone it drops, and stops fighting the moment a creature is on the sidewalk.

1/4.name: Dockside Goon
1/4.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Cargo Hook
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. The goon can pull the target 5 ft toward it unless the target succeeds on a DC 12 STR save.

actions.name: Tire Iron
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Over the Side
special_abilities.desc: When the goon shoves a creature on a pier or a deck, it can push it 10 ft instead of 5, into the water if there is water. Climbing back up a piling is a DC 13 Athletics check.

1/4.name: Night Watchman
1/4.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Nightstick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. Knockout blow from surprise: DC 10 CON save or unconscious for 1d4 x 10 minutes (combat.json brawling).

actions.name: .38 Revolver
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage. Cylinder 6, reload action. Never jams.

actions.name: Pull the Alarm
actions.desc: The watchman pulls a fire or burglar alarm or reaches a telephone. The building's other watchmen come at once; the police arrive in 2d4 + 4 minutes. This adds 2 to the noise count (combat.json noise).

special_abilities.name: Rounds
special_abilities.desc: The watchman walks a fixed route and punches a time clock every hour. Anyone who watches him for one round of his route knows when he will pass each point.

special_abilities.name: Flashlight
special_abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the watchman sweeps his flashlight beam (40 ft). A hidden creature in the beam is no longer hidden from him.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 STR save or be knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

special_abilities.name: On a Chain
special_abilities.desc: Often chained in a yard: it can't move more than 30 ft from its stake. Off the chain, it chases anything that runs.

1/2.name: Crooked Cop
1/2.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Nightstick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. Knockout blow from surprise: DC 12 CON save or unconscious for 1d4 x 10 minutes (combat.json brawling).

actions.name: .38 Revolver
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage. Cylinder 6, reload action. Never jams.

special_abilities.name: Badge
special_abilities.desc: Attacking the crooked cop where anyone can see raises Heat by 1; killing the crooked cop raises it by 3 and puts every cop in the city on the case (investigation.json heat).

special_abilities.name: On the Take
special_abilities.desc: The cop can be bought (investigation.json bribes_and_favors): $10 to look the other way, $50 to lose a report. He is already on someone else's payroll, and a DC 13 Insight check while he talks tells you he is more afraid of them than of you. Paying him is a clue: he tells his other paymaster who else is paying.

1/2.name: Getaway Driver
1/2.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Snub-nose .38
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Cylinder 5, reload action. Never jams.

special_abilities.name: Behind the Wheel
special_abilities.desc: The driver has advantage on Driving checks in chases, and passengers in its car don't have disadvantage firing from it.

special_abilities.name: Floor It
special_abilities.desc: On foot, the driver can Disengage as a bonus action. Driving, it can take a second chase maneuver as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Keeps the Engine Running
special_abilities.desc: The driver is paid to drive, not to die. When the shooting starts, it leaves after 2 rounds whether or not everyone is in the car, unless it was paid extra.

1/2.name: Union Muscle
1/2.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The union muscle makes two Fist attacks, or one Baseball Bat attack.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Baseball Bat
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
special_abilities.desc: The muscle gains +1 AC while an ally is within 5 ft of it.

special_abilities.name: Working Men
special_abilities.desc: Union muscle can be on either side of a strike: hired by the union or by the bosses. They are men with families and a grievance, and a DC 13 Persuasion check that names the grievance can end the fight.

1/2.name: Safecracker
1/2.languages: English and sometimes one other language

actions.name: .32 Pocket Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Magazine 8, reload bonus action. Jams on a natural 1.

actions.name: Dynamite
actions.desc: The safecracker lights and throws a stick (fuse lit as a bonus action): each creature within 10 ft of a point within 60 ft makes a DC 12 DEX save, taking 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. It carries 1d4 sticks.

special_abilities.name: Soft Touch
special_abilities.desc: The safecracker picks a lock as an action and opens a safe by feel in 10 minutes (Mechanics), or in 1 minute with dynamite and a lot of noise.

special_abilities.name: Not a Fighter
special_abilities.desc: The safecracker surrenders when reduced to half its hit points, and will trade what it knows for a head start.
